title: Can Pinnacle Blooms Network's occupational therapy assist in my child's transition to school?
metaTitle: Autism and Transition to School - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network's occupational therapy can support your child with autism in their upcoming transition to school.
html: Most certainly! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand how significant milestone entering school can be for a child, particularly one with autism. Our occupational therapy programs can play a crucial role in preparing your child for this big transition. Therapists work closely with your child to cultivate crucial skills necessary for school, such as sustained attention, social interaction, self-care routines, and even handwriting. In addition, we can help devise strategies to manage potential sensory challenges that can arise in a school environment. Our goal is to make this transition as smooth as possible for your child.
